entry_points.name: delete_account
entry_points.note: Takes a session and a user id, loads the User row and deletes it.

stores.name: users

erasure.note: The route calls session.delete on the User row and commits, so the row is removed.

stores.note: SQLAlchemy table holding the account row.

stores.name: sessions:

fields.name: email
fields.note: The cache key is built from the user's email address.

fields.name: token
fields.note: The session token stored as the value under that key.

erasure.note: purge_session deletes the key but no code in the repository calls it; the delete_account route touches only the database row.

stores.note: Redis key namespace written on login with the session token.

stores.name: stripe.Customer

fields.name: name
fields.note: The user's full name is sent as the customer name.

erasure.note: The repository creates the Stripe customer and contains no call that deletes or redacts it.

stores.note: Stripe customer record created at signup.

stores.name: mixpanel

fields.name: email
fields.note: The email address is passed as the distinct id of the tracked event.

fields.name: account_created
fields.note: The event name recorded against that person.

erasure.note: The repository sends the event and contains no Mixpanel deletion call.

stores.note: Mixpanel event stream written at signup.

stores.name: sendgrid

fields.name: body
fields.note: The message body is built from the user's full name.

stores.note: Transactional mail sent through the SendGrid API client.
